# The warnings of the Compilers workflow's GCC job "with warnings": a Release
# build of the library, its tests and its examples with -Werror, the
# hardening flags and the flags below, which come after the -Wno-* flags of
# CMakeLists.txt. Main builds without any of these warnings.

# -Wextra, but for the warnings of -Wextra listed at the end.
-Wabsolute-value
-Walloc-size
-Wcalloc-transposed-args
-Wcast-function-type
-Wclobbered
-Wempty-body
-Wenum-conversion
-Wexpansion-to-defined
-Wignored-qualifiers
-Wmaybe-uninitialized
-Wmissing-parameter-type
-Woverride-init
-Wshift-negative-value
-Wstring-compare
-Wuninitialized
-Wunused-but-set-parameter

# Format strings: -Wformat=2 adds -Wformat-security and -Wformat-y2k.
-Wformat=2
-Wno-format-nonliteral
-Wformat-overflow=2

# Memory, objects and pointers.
-Walloc-zero
-Walloca
-Wdangling-pointer=2
-Wflex-array-member-not-at-end
-Wpacked
-Wpointer-arith
-Wshift-overflow=2
-Wstringop-overflow=4
-Wuse-after-free=3

# Conditions, declarations and the rest.
-Wdate-time
-Wduplicate-decl-specifier
-Wduplicated-cond
-Wenum-int-mismatch
-Winit-self
-Wmissing-format-attribute
-Wmissing-include-dirs
-Wtrampolines
-Wunused-local-typedefs
-Wdisabled-optimization
-Wvector-operation-performance
